name: Harshvardhan
summary:
Software Engineer specializing in AI, with hands-on experience in LLMs, RAG systems, vector databases, and full-
stack development using Python, Flask, and React. Skilled in building and deploying on-device LLM inference with
Ollama, developing scalable AI-driven applications, and integrating deep learning models into production-ready
systems.
EDUCATION: 1. BCA — Jagannath Institute of Management Sciences (2022) [conf 0.95, review=False]
company_details: 1. Software Developer (Python & AI) @ Createch Software Pvt Ltd (Oct 2024 - Present) [conf 0.98, review=False]

responsibilities: Developed an intelligent chatbot with open-source search and RAG-based chat, enhanced with advanced filters. Integrated audio, text and document translation features, along with map-based search and timeline functionalities. Developed a RAG system with Qdrant for PDF based document querying. Designed frontend UIs for internal apps using Javascript, HTML and CSS. Created CRUD apps for offline systems with seamless data operations using REST APIS. Built a LLM chatbot using Flask & Ollama for secure, on-device inference. Built an LLM based app that converts natural language prompts into SQL queries to interact with a predefined database. Used geoserver for displaying offline based maps.

Built a fully-connected neural network (MLP) from scratch in PyTorch to classify FashionMNIST clothing images. Implemented data normalization, custom train/validation split, early stopping, best-model checkpointing, and visualization of training metrics. Achieved ~88% test accuracy with a clean, modular deep-learning pipeline.

Designed and implemented a Convolutional Neural Network in Pytorch for CIFAR-10 image classification with data augmentation, batch normalization, and dropout. Built custom training and evaluation pipelines with learning rate scheduling and modular model design. RAG Chatbot (Ollama + Qdrant + Flask) - https://github.com/Har02sh/RagChatbot Built an offline RAG system with PDF ingestion, embedding, and semantic search using langhchain, Ollama and Qdrant, integrated with a Flask backend for context-aware question answering. Multi-Agent Workflow Builder (React + Flask + CrewAI) Built a drag-and-drop interface for creating multi-agent pipelines (Research, Summarize, Analysis, Custom). Orchestrated sequential agent execution using crewAI with step-by-step reasoning logs.
